------------------------------ MODULE W4Od7m6p3t1 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Cranes, Slots, Lease, MaxClock

ASSUME Lease \in Nat /\ MaxClock \in Nat

VARIABLES held, inflight, requested, clock

vars == <<held, inflight, requested, clock>>

Grant   == [crane |-> "", slot |-> ""]
NoLive(s) == \A l \in held : ~(l.slot = s /\ l.expiry > clock)

TypeOK ==
    /\ held \subseteq [crane : Cranes, slot : Slots, expiry : 0..(MaxClock + Lease)]
    /\ inflight \subseteq [crane : Cranes, slot : Slots]
    /\ requested \subseteq [crane : Cranes, slot : Slots]
    /\ clock \in 0..MaxClock

Init ==
    /\ held = {}
    /\ inflight = {}
    /\ requested = {}
    /\ clock = 0

Request(c, s) ==
    /\ [crane |-> c, slot |-> s] \notin requested
    /\ requested' = requested \cup {[crane |-> c, slot |-> s]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<held, inflight, clock>>

Issue(c, s) ==
    /\ [crane |-> c, slot |-> s] \in requested
    /\ requested' = requested \ {[crane |-> c, slot |-> s]}
    /\ inflight' = inflight \cup {[crane |-> c, slot |-> s]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<held, clock>>

Deliver(m) ==
    /\ m \in inflight
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {m}
    /\ IF NoLive(m.slot)
         THEN held' = held \cup {[crane |-> m.crane, slot |-> m.slot,
                                  expiry |-> clock + Lease]}
         ELSE held' = held
    /\ UNCHANGED <<requested, clock>>

Release(l) ==
    /\ l \in held
    /\ held' = held \ {l}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inflight, requested, clock>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxClock
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ held' = {l \in held : l.expiry > clock + 1}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inflight, requested>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cranes, s \in Slots : Request(c, s)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes, s \in Slots : Issue(c, s)
    \/ \E m \in inflight : Deliver(m)
    \/ \E l \in held : Release(l)
    \/ Tick

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoDoubleAllocation ==
    \A l1, l2 \in held :
        (l1.slot = l2.slot /\ l1.expiry > clock /\ l2.expiry > clock)
            => l1 = l2
================================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Cranes = {c1, c2}
    Slots = {s1, s2}
    Lease = 2
    MaxClock = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoubleAllocation
nl:
A container-ship crane yard coordinates several gantry cranes that need exclusive short-term use of numbered stacking slots. A crane that wants a slot first records an interest, and a yard controller may then issue a time-limited lease grant for that slot. Grant messages travel over an unreliable link and may be delivered to the cranes in any order, not necessarily the order they were issued. When a crane finally receives a grant it only takes the slot if that slot currently has no live lease, stamping its new lease with an expiry time computed from the shared yard clock. The yard clock advances in ticks, and any lease whose expiry time has passed is considered dead and is swept away. A crane may also voluntarily release a slot it holds before the lease expires. Because grants can be reordered and clocks drift, the controller must ensure that stale grants never let two cranes believe they simultaneously own the same slot.
SAFETY PROPERTY: At no reachable state do two distinct live leases (expiry still in the future) exist for the same stacking slot.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od19m9p1t5 -----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Librarians, Ids, MaxEpoch

VARIABLES record, confirmed, prepared, epoch

vars == <<record, confirmed, prepared, epoch>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ record \subseteq Ids
    /\ confirmed \subseteq Ids
    /\ prepared \subseteq [id : Ids, who : Librarians, snap : SUBSET Ids, ep : 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch

Init ==
    /\ record = {}
    /\ confirmed = {}
    /\ prepared = {}
    /\ epoch = 0

PendingIds == {p.id : p \in prepared}

Begin(l, id) ==
    /\ id \notin confirmed
    /\ id \notin PendingIds
    /\ prepared' = prepared \cup
         {[id |-> id, who |-> l, snap |-> record, ep |-> epoch]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, confirmed, epoch>>

Commit(p) ==
    /\ p \in prepared
    /\ p.ep = epoch
    /\ p.snap = record
    /\ record' = p.snap \cup {p.id}
    /\ confirmed' = confirmed \cup {p.id}
    /\ prepared' = prepared \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED epoch

AdminOverride(p) ==
    /\ p \in prepared
    /\ record' = record \cup {p.id}
    /\ confirmed' = confirmed \cup {p.id}
    /\ prepared' = prepared \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED epoch

Abort(p) ==
    /\ p \in prepared
    /\ prepared' = prepared \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, confirmed, epoch>>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ prepared' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, confirmed>>

Cancel(id) ==
    /\ id \in confirmed
    /\ record' = record \ {id}
    /\ confirmed' = confirmed \ {id}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<prepared, epoch>>

Next ==
    \/ \E l \in Librarians, id \in Ids : Begin(l, id)
    \/ \E p \in prepared : Commit(p)
    \/ \E p \in prepared : AdminOverride(p)
    \/ \E p \in prepared : Abort(p)
    \/ \E id \in Ids : Cancel(id)
    \/ Reconfigure

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostReservation == confirmed \subseteq record
================================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Librarians = {l1, l2}
    Ids = {u1, u2}
    MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostReservation
nl:
A library book reservation system keeps one shared reservation record per title, holding the set of confirmed reservation identifiers. Librarians edit this record with optimistic concurrency: a librarian first reads a private snapshot of the whole record, then later writes back that snapshot merged with the new reservation it is adding. A write only succeeds if the shared record has not changed since the snapshot was taken, which prevents one librarian's write from silently discarding reservations another librarian committed in the meantime. The whole configuration is versioned by an epoch number; an administrator may trigger a reconfiguration that bumps the epoch and cancels every in-flight edit, forcing librarians to start over against the new epoch. The administrator also has a privileged override that can commit a prepared edit even when its snapshot is stale, but the override merges rather than overwrites, so it too preserves earlier reservations. A prepared edit may also simply be abandoned, and a confirmed reservation may be explicitly cancelled, which removes its identifier from the shared record and the confirmed set together. The design goal is that once a reservation identifier is confirmed into the record it is never lost by a later write.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every reservation identifier that has ever been confirmed remains present in the shared record in every reachable state.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od14m9p4t2 -----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS DronesN, DronesS, MaxCap, MaxEpoch

VARIABLES grantsN, grantsS, capacity, epoch

vars == <<grantsN, grantsS, capacity, epoch>>

Used == Cardinality(grantsN) + Cardinality(grantsS)

TypeOK ==
    /\ grantsN \subseteq DronesN
    /\ grantsS \subseteq DronesS
    /\ capacity \in 0..MaxCap
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch

Init ==
    /\ grantsN = {}
    /\ grantsS = {}
    /\ capacity = 2
    /\ epoch = 0

GrantN(d) ==
    /\ d \in DronesN
    /\ d \notin grantsN
    /\ Used < capacity
    /\ grantsN' = grantsN \cup {d}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<grantsS, capacity, epoch>>

ReleaseN(d) ==
    /\ d \in grantsN
    /\ grantsN' = grantsN \ {d}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<grantsS, capacity, epoch>>

GrantS(d) ==
    /\ d \in DronesS
    /\ d \notin grantsS
    /\ Used < capacity
    /\ grantsS' = grantsS \cup {d}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<grantsN, capacity, epoch>>

ReleaseS(d) ==
    /\ d \in grantsS
    /\ grantsS' = grantsS \ {d}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<grantsN, capacity, epoch>>

Reconfigure(newcap) ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ newcap \in 1..MaxCap
    /\ newcap >= Used
    /\ capacity' = newcap
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<grantsN, grantsS>>

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in DronesN : GrantN(d)
    \/ \E d \in DronesN : ReleaseN(d)
    \/ \E d \in DronesS : GrantS(d)
    \/ \E d \in DronesS : ReleaseS(d)
    \/ \E nc \in 1..MaxCap : Reconfigure(nc)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

PoolNeverOverbooked == Used <= capacity
================================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    DronesN = {n1, n2}
    DronesS = {s1, s2}
    MaxCap = 4
    MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT PoolNeverOverbooked
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm shares a single pool of radio channels between two independently operated command instances, one flying the northern drones and one the southern drones. Both instances draw from the same channel pool: when either instance wants to bring one of its drones online it grants that drone a channel, but only if the combined number of channels currently held by both instances is still below the pool capacity. Either instance may also release a channel when a drone lands. The pool is periodically reconfigured under an epoch number as spectrum conditions change; a reconfiguration advances the epoch and resets the pool capacity, but it is only allowed to choose a new capacity that is at least as large as the number of channels already in use, so no in-flight drone is ever cut off. Because the two instances act independently against one shared pool, the coordination rule must guarantee they never jointly oversubscribe the spectrum.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The total number of channels held across both command instances never exceeds the current pool capacity.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od3m8p3t5 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Banks, Lines, Admin

VARIABLES coarse, fine, posted, log

vars == <<coarse, fine, posted, log>>

HoldsFine(b, s) == [bank |-> b, line |-> s] \in fine
FineOwners(s)   == {x.bank : x \in {y \in fine : y.line = s}}

TypeOK ==
    /\ coarse \subseteq Banks
    /\ fine \subseteq [bank : Banks, line : Lines]
    /\ posted \subseteq Lines
    /\ log \subseteq [bank : Banks, line : Lines]

Init ==
    /\ coarse = {}
    /\ fine = {}
    /\ posted = {}
    /\ log = {}

JoinCoarse(b) ==
    /\ b \notin coarse
    /\ coarse' = coarse \cup {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, posted, log>>

AcquireFine(b, s) ==
    /\ b \in coarse
    /\ FineOwners(s) = {}
    /\ s \notin posted
    /\ fine' = fine \cup {[bank |-> b, line |-> s]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, posted, log>>

Post(b, s) ==
    /\ HoldsFine(b, s)
    /\ s \notin posted
    /\ posted' = posted \cup {s}
    /\ log' = log \cup {[bank |-> b, line |-> s]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine>>

ReleaseFine(b, s) ==
    /\ HoldsFine(b, s)
    /\ fine' = fine \ {[bank |-> b, line |-> s]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, posted, log>>

DropCoarse(b) ==
    /\ b \in coarse
    /\ \A s \in Lines : ~HoldsFine(b, s)
    /\ coarse' = coarse \ {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, posted, log>>

AdminSeize(b, s) ==
    /\ b \in coarse
    /\ fine' = {x \in fine : x.line # s} \cup {[bank |-> b, line |-> s]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, posted, log>>

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Banks : JoinCoarse(b)
    \/ \E b \in Banks, s \in Lines : AcquireFine(b, s)
    \/ \E b \in Banks, s \in Lines : Post(b, s)
    \/ \E b \in Banks, s \in Lines : ReleaseFine(b, s)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : DropCoarse(b)
    \/ \E s \in Lines : AdminSeize(Admin, s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoSharedFineLock ==
    \A s \in Lines : Cardinality(FineOwners(s)) <= 1
================================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Banks = {b1, b2}
    Lines = {x1, x2}
    Admin = b1
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoSharedFineLock
nl:
A bank's interbank settlement batch is processed by several member banks that must lock ledger lines before posting settlement entries to them, using a two-level locking discipline. Before a bank may touch any individual ledger line it must first join the coarse batch lock, an intention lock that several banks may hold at once. Only while holding that coarse intention may a bank then acquire the fine, exclusive lock on a specific ledger line, and it may do so only if no other bank currently holds that line's fine lock. Holding the fine lock, a bank may post its settlement entry to that line. A bank releases a fine lock when done, and may drop its coarse intention only once it holds no fine locks. The clearing-house administrator has a privileged override that can seize a line's fine lock for a designated bank, preempting whoever held it, but the seizure still leaves exactly one holder. The discipline must guarantee that no ledger line is ever fine-locked by two different banks at the same moment.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No ledger line is ever held under the exclusive fine lock by two distinct banks simultaneously.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od16m5p5t5 -----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Pharmacists, Scripts, Quorum

VARIABLES onDuty, votes, dispensed, served

vars == <<onDuty, votes, dispensed, served>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ onDuty \subseteq Pharmacists
    /\ votes \in [Scripts -> SUBSET Pharmacists]
    /\ dispensed \subseteq Scripts
    /\ served \in [Scripts -> 0..2]

Init ==
    /\ onDuty = {}
    /\ votes = [s \in Scripts |-> {}]
    /\ dispensed = {}
    /\ served = [s \in Scripts |-> 0]

ClockIn(p) ==
    /\ p \notin onDuty
    /\ onDuty' = onDuty \cup {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, dispensed, served>>

ClockOut(p) ==
    /\ p \in onDuty
    /\ onDuty' = onDuty \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, dispensed, served>>

CastVote(p, s) ==
    /\ p \in onDuty
    /\ s \notin dispensed
    /\ p \notin votes[s]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![s] = @ \cup {p}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<onDuty, dispensed, served>>

WithdrawVote(p, s) ==
    /\ s \notin dispensed
    /\ p \in votes[s]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![s] = @ \ {p}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<onDuty, dispensed, served>>

Dispense(s) ==
    /\ s \notin dispensed
    /\ Cardinality(votes[s]) >= Quorum
    /\ dispensed' = dispensed \cup {s}
    /\ served' = [served EXCEPT ![s] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<onDuty, votes>>

OverrideDispense(s) ==
    /\ s \notin dispensed
    /\ dispensed' = dispensed \cup {s}
    /\ served' = [served EXCEPT ![s] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<onDuty, votes>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Pharmacists : ClockIn(p)
    \/ \E p \in Pharmacists : ClockOut(p)
    \/ \E p \in Pharmacists, s \in Scripts : CastVote(p, s)
    \/ \E p \in Pharmacists, s \in Scripts : WithdrawVote(p, s)
    \/ \E s \in Scripts : Dispense(s)
    \/ \E s \in Scripts : OverrideDispense(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

ReleasedAtMostOnce == \A s \in Scripts : served[s] <= 1
================================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Pharmacists = {p1, p2}
    Scripts = {r1, r2}
    Quorum = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT ReleasedAtMostOnce
nl:
A pharmacy prescription dispenser handles controlled medications, where physically releasing the pills for a prescription is an irreversible act that must never happen twice for the same prescription. Pharmacists clock on and off duty throughout the shift, and only an on-duty pharmacist may cast an approval vote for a given prescription; an on-duty pharmacist may also withdraw a vote it previously cast, as long as the prescription has not yet been dispensed. Normal dispensing is gated by quorum: the machine only releases a prescription once the number of standing approval votes reaches the required quorum and that prescription has not already been released. The pharmacy administrator holds a privileged override that can release a prescription without a full quorum, for emergencies. Whether released by quorum or by override, each release is recorded once and the prescription is thereafter marked dispensed so no further votes or releases apply to it. The controlling safety requirement is that the irreversible release step occurs at most one time per prescription.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Each prescription is physically released at most once across the entire run.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od18m6p0t2 -----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Controllers, Doors, Lease, MaxClock, NONE

VARIABLES holder, expiry, clock, driving, locked

vars == <<holder, expiry, clock, driving, locked>>

Live == holder # NONE /\ expiry > clock

TypeOK ==
    /\ holder \in Controllers \cup {NONE}
    /\ expiry \in 0..(MaxClock + Lease)
    /\ clock \in 0..MaxClock
    /\ driving \subseteq Controllers
    /\ locked \subseteq Doors

Init ==
    /\ holder = NONE
    /\ expiry = 0
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ driving = {}
    /\ locked = {}

Acquire(c) ==
    /\ ~Live
    /\ holder' = c
    /\ expiry' = clock + Lease
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, driving, locked>>

EnterBus(c) ==
    /\ holder = c
    /\ expiry > clock
    /\ c \notin driving
    /\ driving' = driving \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, expiry, clock, locked>>

ToggleDoor(c, d) ==
    /\ c \in driving
    /\ locked' = IF d \in locked THEN locked \ {d} ELSE locked \cup {d}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, expiry, clock, driving>>

LeaveBus(c) ==
    /\ c \in driving
    /\ driving' = driving \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, expiry, clock, locked>>

Release(c) ==
    /\ holder = c
    /\ holder' = NONE
    /\ driving' = driving \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<expiry, clock, locked>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxClock
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ IF expiry <= clock + 1
         THEN holder' = NONE /\ driving' = {}
         ELSE UNCHANGED <<holder, driving>>
    /\ UNCHANGED <<expiry, locked>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Acquire(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : EnterBus(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, d \in Doors : ToggleDoor(c, d)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : LeaveBus(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Release(c)
    \/ Tick

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

BusMutualExclusion ==
    \A c \in driving : (holder = c /\ expiry > clock)
================================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Controllers = {app, voice}
    Doors = {front, back}
    Lease = 2
    MaxClock = 3
    NONE = NONE
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT BusMutualExclusion
nl:
A smart-home door lock network is driven by two independent controller instances, a phone app instance and a voice-assistant instance, that share one pool of door locks over a single radio bus. The radio bus is a critical resource: only one controller may actively drive it at a time, and control is arbitrated by a time-limited lease against a shared clock. A controller acquires the lease only when no live lease exists, stamping an expiry a fixed interval into the future. While holding a live lease a controller may enter the bus, and only while on the bus may it toggle the state of a door in the shared pool. A controller leaves the bus when finished and may release its lease. The clock advances in ticks; when a lease's expiry passes it is torn down and any controller still on the bus under it is forced off. Because two independent instances contend for one bus through leases that can expire, the arbitration must guarantee the bus is never driven by both at once.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every controller currently driving the shared bus is the one and only holder of a still-live lease, so at most one controller drives the bus at any time.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od19m7p5t4 -----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Copies, Patrons, MaxCap, FREE

VARIABLES reg, issued, issueCount, capacity

vars == <<reg, issued, issueCount, capacity>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ reg \in [Copies -> Patrons \cup {FREE}]
    /\ issued \subseteq Copies
    /\ issueCount \in [Copies -> 0..2]
    /\ capacity \in 0..MaxCap

Init ==
    /\ reg = [c \in Copies |-> FREE]
    /\ issued = {}
    /\ issueCount = [c \in Copies |-> 0]
    /\ capacity = 1

CasClaim(p, c) ==
    /\ reg[c] = FREE
    /\ reg' = [reg EXCEPT ![c] = p]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<issued, issueCount, capacity>>

Release(p, c) ==
    /\ reg[c] = p
    /\ c \notin issued
    /\ reg' = [reg EXCEPT ![c] = FREE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<issued, issueCount, capacity>>

Issue(c) ==
    /\ reg[c] # FREE
    /\ c \notin issued
    /\ Cardinality(issued) < capacity
    /\ issued' = issued \cup {c}
    /\ issueCount' = [issueCount EXCEPT ![c] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, capacity>>

AdjustCapacity(n) ==
    /\ n \in Cardinality(issued)..MaxCap
    /\ n # capacity
    /\ capacity' = n
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, issued, issueCount>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Patrons, c \in Copies : CasClaim(p, c)
    \/ \E p \in Patrons, c \in Copies : Release(p, c)
    \/ \E c \in Copies : Issue(c)
    \/ \E n \in 0..MaxCap : AdjustCapacity(n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

IssuedAtMostOnce == \A c \in Copies : issueCount[c] <= 1
================================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Copies = {a, b}
    Patrons = {p1, p2}
    MaxCap = 3
    FREE = FREE
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT IssuedAtMostOnce
nl:
A library book reservation system tracks each physical copy with a single compare-and-swap status register that names the patron currently claiming it or marks it free. A patron claims a copy by a compare-and-swap that succeeds only if the register reads free, atomically flipping it to that patron; if it was already claimed, the attempt simply fails. A patron who has claimed a copy but not yet had it issued may release it, swapping the register back to free. Issuing a copy is the irreversible step: the desk finalizes a claimed copy, and this may happen at most once per copy over the system's life. Issuing is also gated by a circulation capacity that can be adjusted at runtime as staff open or close service desks, but capacity may never be lowered below the number of copies already issued. The essential guarantee is that the irreversible issue of any given copy occurs no more than once.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No physical copy is ever issued more than one time.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od2m4p3t4 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Robots, Slots, MaxCap, NONE

VARIABLES queue, assigned, capacity

vars == <<queue, assigned, capacity>>

Range(q) == {q[i] : i \in 1..Len(q)}
AssignedSlots == {assigned[r] : r \in Robots} \ {NONE}

TypeOK ==
    /\ queue \in Seq(Slots)
    /\ assigned \in [Robots -> Slots \cup {NONE}]
    /\ capacity \in 0..MaxCap

Init ==
    /\ queue = <<>>
    /\ assigned = [r \in Robots |-> NONE]
    /\ capacity = 1

Enqueue(s) ==
    /\ Len(queue) < capacity
    /\ s \notin Range(queue)
    /\ s \notin AssignedSlots
    /\ queue' = Append(queue, s)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<assigned, capacity>>

Assign(r) ==
    /\ assigned[r] = NONE
    /\ Len(queue) > 0
    /\ LET s == Head(queue) IN
        /\ \A r2 \in Robots : assigned[r2] # s
        /\ assigned' = [assigned EXCEPT ![r] = s]
    /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
    /\ UNCHANGED capacity

Complete(r) ==
    /\ assigned[r] # NONE
    /\ assigned' = [assigned EXCEPT ![r] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, capacity>>

Retune(n) ==
    /\ n \in Len(queue)..MaxCap
    /\ n # capacity
    /\ capacity' = n
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, assigned>>

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Enqueue(s)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Assign(r)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Complete(r)
    \/ \E n \in 0..MaxCap : Retune(n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoDoublyAssignedSlot ==
    \A r1, r2 \in Robots :
        (assigned[r1] # NONE /\ assigned[r1] = assigned[r2]) => r1 = r2
================================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Robots = {r1, r2}
    Slots = {s1, s2, s3}
    MaxCap = 3
    NONE = NONE
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoublyAssignedSlot
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet pulls pick jobs from a single bounded dispatch queue. Each job names a distinct pick slot on the floor. A dispatcher enqueues a new job at the tail of the queue, but only when the queue length is still below the current capacity, giving backpressure that stops the dispatcher from overfilling the buffer; it also never enqueues a slot that is already queued or already assigned to a robot. An idle robot takes the job at the head of the queue and becomes assigned to that pick slot, but only if no other robot is currently assigned to that same slot. A robot that finishes its pick reports completion and becomes idle again, freeing its slot. The buffer capacity can be retuned at runtime as floor conditions change, though it is never dropped below the number of jobs presently queued. The safety requirement is that the same pick slot is never simultaneously allocated to two different robots.
SAFETY PROPERTY: At no point are two distinct robots both assigned to the same pick slot.

------------------------------- MODULE W4Od9m1p2t0 -----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS N, Demand

VARIABLES served, shed, token, crashed

vars == <<served, shed, token, crashed>>

Nodes == 0..(N - 1)
Nxt(n) == (n + 1) % N

TypeOK ==
    /\ served \in [Nodes -> 0..Demand]
    /\ shed \in [Nodes -> 0..Demand]
    /\ token \in Nodes
    /\ crashed \subseteq Nodes

Init ==
    /\ served = [n \in Nodes |-> Demand]
    /\ shed = [n \in Nodes |-> 0]
    /\ token = 0
    /\ crashed = {}

ShedUnit(n) ==
    /\ token = n
    /\ n \notin crashed

    /\ proposer \in [Slots -> Machines \cup {NONE}]
    /\ ballots \in [Slots -> SUBSET Machines]
    /\ allocated \subseteq [slot : Slots, machine : Machines]
    /\ capacity \in 0..MaxCap

    /\ proposer = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ ballots = [s \in Slots |-> {}]
    /\ allocated = {}
    /\ capacity = 1

    /\ proposer[s] = NONE
    /\ s \notin SlotsOf(allocated)
    /\ proposer' = [proposer EXCEPT ![s] = m]
    /\ ballots' = [ballots EXCEPT ![s] = {m}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<allocated, capacity>>

Vote(m, s) ==
    /\ proposer[s] # NONE
    /\ s \notin SlotsOf(allocated)
    /\ m \notin ballots[s]
    /\ ballots' = [ballots EXCEPT ![s] = @ \cup {m}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<proposer, allocated, capacity>>

Commit(s) ==
    /\ proposer[s] # NONE
    /\ s \notin SlotsOf(allocated)
    /\ Cardinality(ballots[s]) >= Quorum
    /\ Cardinality(allocated) < capacity
    /\ allocated' = allocated \cup {[slot |-> s, machine |-> proposer[s]]}

    /\ ballots' = [ballots EXCEPT ![s] = {}]

    /\ proposer' = [proposer EXCEPT ![s] = NONE]
    /\ ballots' = [ballots EXCEPT ![s] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<allocated, capacity>>

    /\ x \in allocated
    /\ allocated' = allocated \ {x}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<proposer, ballots, capacity>>

Retune(n) ==
    /\ n \in Cardinality(allocated)..MaxCap
    /\ n # capacity
    /\ capacity' = n
    /\ UNCHANGED <<proposer, ballots, allocated>>

Next ==
    \/ \E m \in Machines, s \in Slots : Propose(m, s)
    \/ \E m \in Machines, s \in Slots : Vote(m, s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Commit(s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Abort(s)

    \/ \E n \in 0..MaxCap : Retune(n)

A network of vending machines coordinates which machine is allowed to stock each shelf slot, and every allocation must be ratified by a quorum vote so no single machine can grab a slot unilaterally. Once a proposal has gathered at least the quorum number of votes, and provided the running total of allocated slots is still under the current capacity, the proposal commits and the slot is allocated to the proposing machine. nl:
A print shop job spooler commits each print job across several printer participants using a two-phase commit protocol, so that the irreversible act of physically printing a job happens at most once. Each job starts uninitialized. The coordinator opens voting on a job, which moves it into the voting phase and clears every participant's vote. A participant may be slow but is never considered failed, so the coordinator simply waits for a temporarily off-duty printer to return and vote rather than giving up on it. A job commits, and is printed, only when it is in the voting phase and every participant has voted yes; committing is irreversible and a committed job is never reopened. If any participant votes no, the job is aborted. The guarantee that matters is that no job is ever printed more than once.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Each print job is physically printed at most one time.

A write only lands if the board still equals the snapshot the librarian took, so no write ever clobbers a confirmation another librarian recorded in between.
